page.layout: One column of running text; running head with page number at the top right; marginal notes in the right margin beside lines 4 to 7 (references a and b); catchword/signature line at the foot ("Cc 3" signature, "memo-" catchword-like hyphenated word at the right).

main_text.p: fibi viderentur ex quibusdam parabolicis in Euangelio positis Domini sermonibus, haud absurde concludere; quales isti sunt, a Matth. 25.27. apud Matthæum a quidem, Oportuit te committere pecuniam meam numulariis, sive trapezitis; apud Lucam b vero hi, in quibus Crojus noster præcipue pedem figit, b Luc. 19.13. ραγ- ματεύσασθε, ἕως ἔρχομαι, Negotiamini, dum venio. Hæc, inquam, & alia nunc mitto. Nam ad præsens institutum satis est attendisse hanc celeberrimam in veteri illa Ecclesia sententiam, estote probi trapezitæ; Patres, non Constitutionum authori (quod nemo eorum prodit) sed Scripturis canonicis constanter acceptam ferre; plane, ut ipsos Διατάγεας, quo loco eam memorant; in eo tantum, cætera concordes, discrepare; quod eam alii Apostolis, ut Dionysius, alii Christo Servatori, ut Origenes, & Hieronymus, tribuunt. Ac horum quidem est difficilior, & impeditior ratio. Dionysii vero nostri, qui hanc sententiam φονλὼ Ἀποστολικὼ vocat, & Clementis, qui ejusdem Pauli ad Thessalonicenses verba continuavit, multo facilior, atque explicatior ratio est. page.notes: The Greek words in the text (ραγματεύσασθε, Διατάγεας, φονλὼ Ἀποστολικὼ) and the phrase "ex quibusdam" are reproduced from a low-resolution scan and may contain errors; the Greek "ἕως ἔρχομαι" and the Greek heading fragments are doubtful. The first marginal note letter "a" and "b" marks are inferred from the margin. Catchword "memo-" is at the foot right and is a hyphenated line-end word.
